fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. ticket unblocked-by <id> scopes to tickets that directly or transitively depend on <id> through depends_on edges and treats <id> as the satisfied prerequisite for the query. 2. JSON output includes the queried root ticket, actionable items, still_blocked_items, and remaining blocker counts and ids so callers can distinguish what became actionable from what is still affected but blocked. 3. Human-readable output reuses the compact recommendation card style for actionable items and renders a dedicated Still Blocked section instead of generic object dumps. 4. Focused ticket-cli regression coverage proves newly actionable dependents and still-blocked impacted dependents are both surfaced correctly.
fields.title: [ticket-cli] Add unblocked-by command for newly actionable dependents

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. ticket unblocked-by <id> continues to scope to tickets that directly or transitively depend on <id> through depends_on edges and shows which impacted dependents are actionable versus still blocked. 2. ticket next accepts an optional ticket id or prefix; when present, it returns the next actionable tickets to finish within the remaining blocker set for reverse dependents reachable from that root. 3. Root-scoped next output makes it clear which prerequisite root is being analyzed and preserves the existing ranking and board-awareness behavior of ticket next. 4. Focused ticket-cli regressions prove the scoped next view returns blocker work that advances the dependents surfaced by unblocked-by <id>.
